=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2698-2701 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Prefix assignments of PR_CHECKS_HEAD_REF and REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW on the call to the sourced function _pr_wait_for_required_checks are claimed to persist in the shared poller shell, so a fork-head PR clears the step-wide ci.yml for later PRs.
  WHY: Later same-repo PRs in the same tick would not dispatch final CI and would be refused checks_incomplete. Disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 rejected the claim, saying bash scopes the prefix to the call and the same pattern is used at scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1768. Severity is the highest given (MAJOR).
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1481,1723 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW is set step-wide, so other callers of the wait helper (noop-suspicious gate D, base-freshness update) also dispatch ci.yml, and STALL_MERGE_REQUIRED_CHECKS_ENABLED=false does not turn that off.
  WHY: Severity disagrees: NIT (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, confidence 2, not raised as a defect), MAJOR (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, confidence 5), and minimax_minimax-m3 did not flag it as a defect. The behaviour is documented in the README and the agents.d fragment.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:shellcheck check-run | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: A shellcheck failure was reported in the pre-push test gate.
  WHY: CI failures block the PR merge. Disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 could not verify it (the check-run shows failed_count 0, and shellcheck was reportedly OOM-killed in the sandbox).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2698-2701 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The step-wide REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW is passed as a command-prefix assignment to a sourced shell function, and the reviewer claims this persists after the function returns (POSIX 2.9.1). With an empty head_ref (fork or deleted fork), the main shell's REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW is cleared and PR_CHECKS_HEAD_REF is left set.
  WHY: Later same-repo PRs in the same tick would skip final-CI dispatch, be refused checks_incomplete and burn the recovery budget (the PR #9564 / #9520 failure). Gate D (line 36841) and the base-freshness update (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1758) would also lose the dispatch. The new test never asserts the post-call value.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh 2698-2701. Save and restore REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW and PR_CHECKS_HEAD_REF around the call (about 4 lines).
